prompt.main_subject: An adult woman demonstrates a rapid makeup transformation from bare-face appearance to a finished glamorous look.
prompt.composition_elements: Fixed medium close-up, vertical 9:16, simple gradient background, white countdown from 01:00 to 00:00, bilingual step labels, and clearly distinguishable rapid transitions.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright clean studio lighting and efficient accelerated beauty-challenge rhythm.

technical_specs.motion: Rapid foundation, contour, eye, cheek, lip, hair, and accessory transitions.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical beauty short of approximately 10 seconds titled "One Minute Makeup". An adult woman appears in a fixed medium close-up against a simple solid-color gradient background under bright clean studio lighting. Display a white digital countdown beginning at 01:00 and counting uniformly to 00:00. Show each key step rapidly but clearly: bare-face opening, Foundation and Concealer, Highlight, Blend, Loose Powder, Eyeshadow, Eyeliner and Mascara, Blush, Lipstick/Lip Gloss, then Hairstyle and Accessories. When the hair step appears, display "You forgot to curl hair" as the source label while hair changes to fluffy long curls and jewelry appears. Use concise bilingual Chinese/English labels as supplied by the source. At zero, hold a confident finished makeup look. Keep transitions smooth and avoid plastic skin or excessive retouching.
prompt.negative_prompt: plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, beauty filter, over-saturated, HDR look, blurry, watermark, unintended text, extra fingers, deformed, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing
